OFFENSE: Special Attacks Mind Blast, Thought Tentacle
At Will - Amanuensis, Dark Orb, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Moment, Read Magic
1st - Dark (DC 15), Delayed Opponent (DC 15), Deceleration (DC 15), Mage Armor, True Strike
2nd - Dark II (DC 16), Dimension Hop, Elemental Resistance
3rd - Bio (DC 17), Blink, Dark III (DC 17), Darkra (DC 17), Dimension Step, Dispel, Fly, Haste, Mass Deceleration (DC 17), Slow (DC 17)
STATISTICS: Str 12, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 19, Wis 17, Cha 17
Base Atk +9; CMB +10 (+12 grapple); CMD 22 (24 vs grapple)
Feats Ability Focus (Mind Blast), Combat Casting, Improved Grapple, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +16, Diplomacy +16, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (Arcana) +17, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +17, Stealth +15
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Mindflayers are able to project a 60 foot of psychic static towards a single target. The target is stunned for 1d4 rounds and takes 8d6 points of non-elemental damage. A successful Will save (DC 20) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. This ability is used as a standard action is considered a mind-affecting effect and the saving throw DC is Charisma-based. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Dungeoneering DC 25).

If a mindflayer has someone grappled and successfully deals damage to that target, instead of the normal physical damage, it can choose to deal 1d4+2 points of Intelligence damage instead. This ability only works on creatures with an actual brain. Thus, it does not work on constructs, elementals, plants, oozes or undead in addition to creatures that either do not have an actual brain or the brain is not physically inside the grappled creature.

curation.summary: Mindflayer is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 37 generated item(s) across 7 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
